messages:
Becca H: Heads-up  planning a small social push for the Apr 12 webinar. Idea: nano/micro X seeding + 4 LinkedIn advocates. Need schedule + assets.

Ravi P: Sounds good. Proposed cadence: teaser 4 days out, demo clip 2 days out, registration nudge day-of. Short CTAs on X, longer LinkedIn posts.

Lena (Content): I'll create: 15s teaser vertical, 25s demo square, 1-pager with 3 CTAs, and 3 caption variants (snappy, metric-led, story). Need UTMs.

Eli (Ops): Reminder from campaign-bot: 48h lead time for crossposting/approvals. Also allocate monitoring windows for replies/DMs.

Theo M: Budget question  we have $2k flex. Propose three paid boosts on X (800/600/400) + 200 holdback. Approve?

Becca H: approve split. Theo please run boosts Wed morning and drop receipts. Also run A/B for CTA: "Reserve your spot" vs "Save my seat" across boosts.

Lena (Content): Drafts in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/klmn9012/Apr12-Webinar-Assets. I'll include placeholder overlay: "XX% latency improvement" pending eng confirm.

Ravi P: I'll assemble advocates: 4 partners, 2 customers, 2 internal. Will DM asks + ask them to comment 24h after posting to boost reach.

Eli (Ops): Monitoring plan: I'll cover Wed + Fri pushes (1h pre/post). Need short DM templates for replies.

Lena (Content): DM templates here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/def456 (edit access). Three quick replies: thanks + link, reminder + agenda, speaker highlight + signup.

Becca H: Action list:
- Lena: assets + captions + Figma by Wed COB
- Ravi: advocates list + outreach by Thu AM
- Theo: execute boosts + receipts by Thu EOD
- Eli: monitoring rota + tracker post in #marketing-campaigns after push

campaign-bot: Campaign slot reserved 4/8-4/12. Ensure approvals in 48h.

Becca H: If no objections I'll lock schedule at EOD.
